text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to the office for a meeting
with
Mejiro Ardan when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! S-sorry! Couldja help me out a sec here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Tamamo. What seems to be
the
matter?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's her... She's comin' after me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Taaamtaaam! Wherever have you
gone?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's her! There's no time to explain,
just
lemme in, fast!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whewww! Ya sure saved me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo, are you playing a game of hide
and
seek with Creek? Hehe, you
certainly are close
friends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
As if! If ya hadn't stepped in just now, I
woulda
been stuck bein' her dolly all
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Dear me... I think I'll let you get your
bearings
before I press you for further
details.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So, ya see, it all started with Creak
winnin' dis
fancy rattle toy from a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She just had to try it out... so she tried to make me act like some googoo gaga baby doll.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My... so that's what had you feeling so
concerned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
From what I can gather, however... it
sounds as
though Creek simply wished to
play with you,
Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You don't know what she's like, Ardan! I'd like to see you put up with bein' treated like a baby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't I accompany
you? That
would make things less
frightening, I assume?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean yeah, maybe, but... real talk, I
don't
think I got it in me to see Creek
right now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Come now, you're just winded from all
the
running. Let's go and speak with
Creek once
you've had a chance to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and lie down here... You can
rest your
head on my lap. There's
nothing to be afraid of.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: K-kay...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This reminds me of when the young
Mejiro
children would get tuckered out
and then come
along to my room for an
afternoon nap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I feel as though I've just gained a
younger
sister. You're safe here... Sleep
tight...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-younger... sister?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold up a sec! You're doin' exactly da
same thing
Creek was gonna do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that how it seems?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nope, I'm not fallin' for it! No one's treatin' me like a kid!
choice_data_list: お姉さんっぽいところがあるからね
赤ちゃんにされるよりは……
choice_data_list_en: She does have that big sister vibe to her.
Better than being treated like a baby...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm not outta the woods yet! I gotta get
back to
my room!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: W-wait—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Tamtam! ♪ I've been looking
everywhere for
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: GYAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, a no-holds-barred game of cat
and
mouse ensues, with Mejiro Ardan
chasing after
them both in an attempt to
mediate.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grrraaahhh! I don't like either of those options, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But fine... I'll take Ardan over Creek for
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's an honor to be your safe
haven. Now,
try to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Shall I sing you a lullaby? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gahhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the sound of lullabies fills the office,
Tamamo
Cross lies with her head on
Mejiro Ardan's lap, a
defeated look on
her face.
